reactions.name: Ethereal Step (3/Day)
reactions.description: When targeted by a creature within 60 feet, she either slips into the Ethereal Plane until her next turn starts or teleports up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against powers, spells and supernatural effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing; against a spellcaster, one spellcasting ability score drops by 1 until a rest and the leyleech becomes charged for 1 minute.

actions.name: Magic Purge (Charged Form Only)
actions.description: Ends its charge; a creature within 30 feet makes a DC 11 Constitution save: 7 (2d6) force, half on success.

monster:lich-mcdm.damageResistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks
monster:lich-mcdm.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: Destroyed with the soulstone intact (AC 19, 50 hit points, only force and thunder harm it), its soul enters it: creatures seeing it make a DC 20 Charisma save or are charmed into touching it. A toucher makes a DC 20 Constitution save: on a failure it drops to 0 and the lich reforms at full; on a success it loses half its hit points and the lich reforms at half.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against powers, spells and supernatural effects.

traits.name: Turn and Dazed Immunity
traits.description: Immune to turning and can't be dazed.

traits.name: Utility Spells
traits.description: Charisma, save DC 20. At will: arcane lock, charm person, detect magic, detect thoughts, disguise self, identify, locate object, mage hand. 3/day each: arcane eye, arcanist's magic aura, contact other plane, legend lore, scrying. 1/day each: forbiddance, geas, hallow, mirage arcane, symbol.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Glare of Undeath and four attacks in any mix of Biting Acid, Disruptive Thunder and Pain of Ages.

actions.name: Biting Acid
actions.description: Ranged spell attack, +12, range 120 ft.; 22 (5d8) acid, and the target can't regain hit points until the lich's next turn starts.

actions.name: Disruptive Thunder
actions.description: Melee or ranged spell attack, +12, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 22 (4d10) thunder, and a Huge or smaller target can be moved up to 45 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Pain of Ages
actions.description: Melee or ranged spell attack, +12, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one creature; 21 (6d6) psychic, and its first hit before the lich's next turn deals half damage.

actions.name: Glare of Undeath
actions.description: A creature within 60 feet makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is restrained hugging itself for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn; an ally's DC 20 Persuasion check as an action ends it).

actions.name: Horrid Woe (2/Day)
actions.description: A creature within 90 feet makes a DC 20 Constitution save: 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic, half on success. At 0 it is stable but can't heal, and its spirit becomes a wraith obeying the lich until the wraith or lich is destroyed.

actions.name: Life Absorption (1/Day, Concentration)
actions.description: Enemies within 120 feet make a DC 20 Constitution save or take 16 (3d10) necrotic at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute, the lich gaining that much as temporary hit points.

bonusActions.name: Necrotic Form
bonusActions.description: Becomes shadow and moves up to its speed: immune to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, grappled and restrained, passes 1-inch gaps; reverts at turn end.

reactions.name: Immortal Insight
reactions.description: When another creature it can see makes an attack, check or save, it imposes advantage or disadvantage.

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.description: Half-damage saves deal no damage on a success and half on a failure.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.description: Moving 20 feet straight then hitting with Claw forces a DC 15 Strength save or prone; it can then Bite the prone target as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite and two Claw attacks, or two Tail Whips.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing.

actions.name: Tail Whip
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 15 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) radiant.

actions.name: Hypnotic Mane (1/Day)
actions.description: Creatures within 15 feet make a DC 14 Wisdom save or are charmed for 1 minute (incapacitated, speed 0) until damaged or shaken out of it as an action.

reactions.name: Afterimage
reactions.description: When hit by a sight-reliant attacker without truesight, it reappears up to 30 feet away and the attack misses.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Breathes air and water; survives 8 hours out of water.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.description: Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end grappled.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing.

actions.name: Electric Pulse
actions.description: A creature within 20 feet makes a DC 12 Constitution save (disadvantage if touching the eel): 18 (4d8) lightning and dazed until the end of its next turn, half and not dazed on success.

monster:lightthief.languages: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak

actions.name: Necrotic Drain
actions.description: Melee spell attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic, or 13 (3d6 + 3) if the target can't see it.

actions.name: Into the Light (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Teleports inside a light source within 15 feet, gaining total cover; if the light is put out by other means, it is ejected within 5 feet and paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Steal Light (Inside Light Source Only)
actions.description: Creatures within 15 feet of the light make a DC 13 Constitution save: 14 (4d6) radiant and lose darkvision for 1 minute, half only on success; the light goes out and it appears within 5 feet.

traits.name: Exceptional Smell
traits.description: +10 to smell-based Perception checks, even through dirt, snow and water.

traits.name: Natural Camouflage
traits.description: Advantage on Stealth in its native terrain.

actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing, or maximum damage against a Plant.

actions.name: Swat
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing or bludgeoning, and a DC 13 Strength save or prone.
